adoptionStatus: adopted 2026-11-21 per maintainer ruling: devin_pro × swe-2 updated from expired promo_until=2026-10-31 to standing unmetered in Desktop/CLI per 2026-11-12 blog + devin.ai/pricing, with docs.devin.ai/desktop/models lingering 2026-11-30 text noted for Dec 1 recheck

alreadyInRepo.adopted: devin_pro × swe-2：unmetered=true，promo_until=2026-10-31，data_date=2026-09-10。该截止日期在本扫描日（2026-11-19）已经过期。#245 指出限时免费已改永久免费，表里还显示旧截止日期。
alreadyInRepo.research: devin-swe2-round1-2026-09-12.json 在 main；PR #234 另有 mirrercrouse-devin-swe2-weekly9-x-2026-11-16.json 等，不是本条政策冲突的归档。

blog.quote: We're also making free SWE-2 in Devin Desktop and CLI a permanent part of our Teams, Pro, and Max plans.

docsDesktopModels.quote: SWE-2 is free for self-serve plans in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI through November 30, 2026; it does not apply to Devin cloud sessions. List pricing ($3.00/1M input, $15.00/1M output, $0.30/1M cache input) applies afterward.
docsDesktopModels.swe2FlashNote: SWE-2 Flash is free until December 4, 2026 at 18:00 UTC.

selfServeDocs.note: Teams Free mode: each member can run up to 2 cloud sessions at a time at no cost, powered by SWE-2. This is cloud Free mode, distinct from Desktop/CLI free SWE-2.

corroboratingPosts.author: jomagonmar
corroboratingPosts.visual: 图1 就是 docs.devin.ai Desktop Models 页，蓝条原文与本轮抓取一致：self-serve Desktop/CLI 免费到 2026-11-30，之后 $3/$15/$0.30，且不适用 cloud。图2 是 Devin 选择器，可见 SWE-2 Lightning / Flash，不是配额条。口述「免费到 11 月 30 号」跟文档一致，但与 11-12 博客「permanent」冲突。

corroboratingPosts.author: toolsbisnis
corroboratingPosts.visual: 不是官方页，是模型合成摘要（自称 60 sources）。它已经点出博客/定价页写永久、部分文档仍写 30 Nov。只作讨论回声，不算独立官方证据。

whyNotAdoptYet: adopted 里 promo_until=2026-10-31 已过期，#245 的「不要还显示旧截止日期」成立，但不能在官方冲突未裁定前改成「永久免费」或「到 11-30」。博客与定价页（付费档 Desktop+CLI 永久免费）和当前文档（到 2026-11-30，之后按 list price，且不包括 cloud）相互矛盾。SWE-2 Flash 另有 2026-12-04 18:00 UTC 截止。建议研究归档冲突，由维护者裁定 adopted 行怎么改。
